title: UploadInitResponse
description: Response to POST /api/v1/tests/{test_id}/summary (upload phase 1). Returns the upload session id and the subset of manifest files the server still needs — the file-granularity resume mechanism. See contracts/upload/README.md.

upload_id.description: ULID-prefixed upload-session id. Stable across re-POSTs of the same manifest for the same test_id (idempotent initiate).

needed_paths.description: Manifest paths the server does NOT already hold with a matching hash. Empty array means every file is already present and the client may go straight to POST .../complete.
